latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate structured, blameless postmortem reports from incident data.

- Create postmortems from timelines, alerts, chat logs, and deploys.
- Analyze root causes using the "5 Whys"; include contributing/mitigating factors.
- Output reports following Google SRE & Etsy blameless postmortem formats.
- Support for action item tracking and follow-up analysis.
- Provide commands for generating, reviewing, and tracking postmortems.
